target.statement: Classical K-means on the SMARVUS empirical data (6 psychometric features, cleaned N=8,360) selects k=2 with average silhouette ≈ 0.31 and ARI ≈ 0.999 (SD 0.001) across initializations
target.table_ref: Section 3.5, Figure 24 (empirical data silhouette/SSE vs k)
target.dataset: SMARVUS (Terry et al. 2023), 6 features: STARS, R-TAS, BFNE-S, LSAS-SR, CAS, IUS-SF

compute.basis: K-means with k=2..10 and multiple K-means++ restarts on ~8k x 6 data plus silhouette/ARI is seconds of CPU; most time is downloading SMARVUS and re-deriving the attention-check cleaning to N=8,360, which the paper describes only in prose.

blockers: Cleaning pipeline (attention-check and attention-amnesty exclusions reducing 12,570 to 8,360) is described only in prose; exact item-level rules must be inferred from the SMARVUS codebook
OSF repo link is view-only and may not contain the exact empirical cleaning/analysis script
Exact silhouette value depends on random seed and number of restarts, so ~0.31 may not match to the decimal
title: Drawing Lines in Psychological Space: What K-means Clustering Reveals in Simulated and Real Psychometric Data
